title: Product image model and asset review
usage: Copy one record per model revision, intended use, child SKU and asset revision. Record a source for each decision. Empty fields mean unknown.
decision_rules: Hold the proposed deployment while its permission basis is missing. Record research-only use separately.
Freeze visible requirements before generating candidates. Record each as pass, fail or unobservable and retain the supporting reference.
Reject a contradicted required detail. Route unobservable details for review. Recheck all hard requirements on every repaired revision.
Release requires documented use permission and a passing asset review for the intended channel.

example.basis: Hypothetical review of a fictional drill kit. No generated image, model run or merchant observation.
example.reference: One cordless drill, one supplied battery and a belt clip. Charger sold separately.

candidates.observation: Charger shown beside the drill as an included accessory.
candidates.decision: Reject depiction; conflicts with the included contents.

candidates.observation: Charger removed; crop now hides the required belt clip.
candidates.decision: Hold for a view that shows the clip.

example.reuse: Reuse this original form with attribution to MarketplaceBeta Research and retain its date and hypothetical labels.
